statement.en: Apply the documented Menus guidance to remove articles like a, an, and the from menu-item labels to save space.
statement.ja: 「Menus」において「Remove articles like a, an, and the from menu-item labels to save space」の指針を適用する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

statement.en: Remove articles such as a, an, and the from English menu-item labels to save space.
statement.ja: メニュー項目の英語ラベルでは、a、an、theなどの冠詞を省いてスペースを節約する。

conditions: In English, articles lengthen labels but rarely make their meaning clearer.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Replace the generic apply-guidance template with the direct recommendation and retain the explicit English-language context.

statement.en: Present people when a menu item is unavailable in the documented context.
statement.ja: 該当する状況でpeople when a menu item is unavailableを表示する。

conditions: Dim an unavailable item and prevent it from responding to interactions.

statement.en: Make it clear when a menu item is unavailable.
statement.ja: メニュー項目が利用できないことを明示する。

conditions: An unavailable item often appears dimmed and does not respond to interaction.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Repair malformed Present people wording; dimming is the source's common presentation, not the only permitted implementation.

statement.en: Choose or apply menu item icons sparingly and with purpose in the documented context.
statement.ja: 該当する状況ではmenu item icons sparingly and with purposeを採用する。

statement.en: Use menu-item icons sparingly and for a clear purpose.
statement.ja: メニュー項目のアイコンは目的を持って控えめに使う。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Replace the machine-generated choose-or-apply template with the actual icon recommendation.

statement.en: Apply the documented Menus guidance to apply a uniform visual treatment across menu items in the same group.
statement.ja: 「Menus」において「Apply a uniform visual treatment across menu items in the same group」の指針を適用する。

statement.en: Give menu items in the same group a consistent visual treatment.
statement.ja: 同じグループのメニュー項目は視覚的な扱いを統一する。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Remove the apply-documented-guidance wrapper while retaining the all-icons-or-no-icons condition.

statement.en: Favor listing important or frequently used menu items first when the documented conditions apply.
statement.ja: 該当条件ではlisting important or frequently used menu items firstを優先する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

statement.en: Prefer placing important or frequently used menu items first.
statement.ja: 重要または頻繁に使うメニュー項目を先に並べることを優先する。

conditions: People tend to scan menus from the top, so high-priority items placed first are easier to find.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Replace the broken conditional template with the direct preference and its actual context.

statement.en: Evaluate whether grouping logically related items is appropriate for the current context.
statement.ja: grouping logically related itemsが現在の状況に適切か検討する。

statement.en: Consider grouping logically related menu items.
statement.ja: 論理的に関連するメニュー項目をグループ化することを検討する。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: State the grouping option directly, retaining MAY and the platform-appropriate separator context.

statement.en: Keep logically related menu commands in one group even when their importance differs.
statement.ja: importanceが異なっても論理的に関連するmenu commandは同じgroupにまとめる。

statement.en: Prefer keeping logically related menu commands in one group even when their importance differs.
statement.ja: 重要度が異なっても、論理的に関連するメニューコマンドを同じグループにまとめることを優先する。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Keep the source's explicit preference rather than an unconditional-sounding grouping command.

statement.en: Apply the documented Menus guidance to be mindful of menu length.
statement.ja: 「Menus」において「Be mindful of menu length」の指針を適用する。

statement.en: Be mindful of menu length.
statement.ja: メニューの長さに配慮する。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Remove the generic apply-guidance wrapper; preserve both the shortening options and the user-defined/dynamic-content exception.

statement.en: Choose or apply submenus sparingly in the documented context.
statement.ja: 該当する状況ではsubmenus sparinglyを採用する。

conditions: Consider a submenu when one term repeats in more than two items in a group.
Use the repeated term in the parent label when it helps predict submenu contents.

statement.en: Use submenus sparingly.
statement.ja: サブメニューは控えめに使う。

conditions: Consider a submenu when a term repeats in more than two items in the same group.
Using the repeated term in the parent label generally works well to help people predict the submenu's contents.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Repair the template and preserve the generally-works-well qualification for the repeated parent-label term.

statement.en: Favor using a submenu to indenting menu items when the documented conditions apply.
statement.ja: 該当条件ではusing a submenu to indenting menu itemsを優先する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

statement.en: Prefer a submenu over indenting menu items.
statement.ja: メニュー項目を字下げするより、サブメニューの使用を優先する。

conditions: Indentation is inconsistent with the system and does not clearly communicate relationships among menu items.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Make the submenu-versus-indentation preference intelligible in both languages.

statement.en: Evaluate whether using a changeable label that describes an item’s current state is appropriate for the current context.
statement.ja: using a changeable label that describes an item’s current stateが現在の状況に適切か検討する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

statement.en: Consider a menu-item label that changes to reflect its current state.
statement.ja: 現在の状態に応じて変わるメニュー項目ラベルを検討する。

conditions: For example, one item can change between Show Map and Hide Map instead of listing both items.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Replace the generic evaluation template with the optional changing-label pattern and its concrete state-dependent context.

statement.en: Apply the documented Menus guidance to include a verb if a changeable label isn’t clear enough.
statement.ja: 「Menus」において「Include a verb if a changeable label isn’t clear enough」の指針を適用する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

statement.en: Include a verb when a changing menu-item label does not clearly distinguish an action from a state.
statement.ja: 変化するメニュー項目ラベルで操作と状態の区別が不明確な場合は、動詞を含める。

conditions: For example, adding Turn to HDR On or HDR Off can clarify that the item performs an action.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: State the conditional verb recommendation directly instead of generic apply-guidance wording.

statement.en: Evaluate whether using a checkmark to show that an attribute is currently in effect is appropriate for the current context.
statement.ja: using a checkmark to show that an attribute is currently in effectが現在の状況に適切か検討する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

statement.en: Consider a checkmark to show that a menu attribute is currently active.
statement.ja: メニューで現在有効な属性を示すために、チェックマークを検討する。

conditions: Checkmarks help people scan an attribute list for selected options, such as styles applied to selected text.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Replace the template with the optional selected-attribute indicator and its source-supported context.

statement.en: Evaluate whether offering a menu item that makes it easy to remove multiple toggled attributes is appropriate for the current context.
statement.ja: offering a menu item that makes it easy to remove multiple toggled attributesが現在の状況に適切か検討する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

statement.en: Consider a menu item that removes multiple toggled attributes at once.
statement.ja: 切り替え可能な複数の属性を一度に解除できるメニュー項目を検討する。

conditions: For example, when several text styles can be applied, a Plain item can remove all applied formatting attributes.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Replace the template with the optional bulk-removal action; retain the text-style case as an example.

statement.en: Apply the documented Menus guidance to let players navigate in-game menus using the platform’s default interaction method.
statement.ja: 「Menus」において「Let players navigate in-game menus using the platform’s default interaction method」の指針を適用する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

statement.en: Let players navigate in-game menus with the platform’s default interaction method.
statement.ja: ゲーム内メニューを、そのプラットフォームの標準的な操作方法で移動できるようにする。

conditions: Use the interactions people expect for other menus on the device; examples include touch on iOS and iPadOS, and direct or indirect gestures on visionOS.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Replace the template, prioritize input constraints, and index the named platform-specific interaction examples without requiring both on every platform.
Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: The supported MUST protects readable and operable menus across platforms and belongs to accessibility priority.

statement.en: Choose a small or medium iOS or iPadOS menu layout when it streamlines people’s choices.
statement.ja: 選択を効率化できる場合はiOSまたはiPadOSのsmallまたはmedium menu layoutを選ぶ。

conditions: Small places four icon-only items above the remaining list.
Medium places three symbol-and-short-label items above the remaining list.
Large is the default and displays every item in one list.

statement.en: Choose a small or medium iOS or iPadOS menu layout when it can help streamline people’s choices.
statement.ja: 選択を効率化する助けになる場合は、iOSまたはiPadOSのsmallまたはmediumメニューレイアウトを選ぶ。

conditions: Small places four symbol-or-icon items without labels above the remaining list.
Medium places three symbol-or-icon items with short labels above the remaining list.
Large is the default and displays every item in one list.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Preserve can-help instead of a guaranteed outcome, and retain symbol-or-icon alternatives for both compact layouts.

statement.en: Favor displaying a menu near the content it controls when the documented conditions apply.
statement.ja: 該当条件ではdisplaying a menu near the content it controlsを優先する。

conditions: Keep the menu close enough that people can see the controlled content while looking and tapping.

statement.en: Prefer displaying a visionOS menu near the content it controls.
statement.ja: visionOSのメニューは、それが操作するコンテンツの近くに表示することを優先する。

conditions: People look at a menu item before tapping it and may miss its effect if the controlled content is too far away.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Repair the template and preserve the attention-shift rationale without requiring simultaneous viewing of both locations; index gaze and tapping.

statement.en: Favor the subtle breakthrough effect in most cases when the documented conditions apply.
statement.ja: 該当条件ではthe subtle breakthrough effect in most casesを優先する。

conditions: Use subtle or automatic to preserve legibility, depth, and scene context.
exceptions: Use prominent only when scene-wide visibility is important and account for disruption or discomfort.
Use none when intentional occlusion is part of the experience and accept reduced visibility and access.

statement.en: Prefer the subtle breakthrough effect for visionOS menus in most cases.
statement.ja: visionOSのメニューでは、多くの場合subtleのbreakthrough effectを優先する。

conditions: The subtle effect maintains legibility and usability while preserving scene depth and context.
For a menu that overlaps 3D content, choosing automatic applies subtle by default.
exceptions: Prominent is an option when displaying a menu over the entire scene is important, but it can disrupt the experience or cause discomfort.
None is an option for fully occluding a menu behind 3D content, such as a barrier-based puzzle, but it may make the menu difficult to see and access.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Prioritize legibility and discomfort, limit the automatic default to overlapping 3D content, and preserve prominent/none as optional alternatives rather than required choices.

statement.en: Represent common actions consistently in the documented context.
statement.ja: 該当する状況でcommon actions consistentlyを表現する。

statement.en: Represent common menu actions consistently.
statement.ja: 共通のメニュー操作は一貫した表現にする。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Remove malformed mixed-language template wording and retain the standard-icon examples.

conditions: Use a verb or verb phrase for an item that initiates an action.
In general, use a verb or verb phrase for an item that initiates an action.
Let the app's or game's communication style guide the label's tone.
exceptions: Depending on menu layout, iOS, iPadOS, and visionOS apps can show a few unlabeled items identified only by symbols or icons.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Restore the general verb-label qualification and the explicit page-note exception for a few icon-only items on the named platforms.

statement.en: Use title-style capitalization for menu-item labels to match platform experience.
statement.ja: platform experienceに合わせてmenu-item labelにtitle-style capitalizationを使う。

conditions: A game's distinct writing style may justify a different treatment.

statement.en: Generally prefer title-style capitalization for English menu-item labels.
statement.ja: 英語のメニュー項目ラベルでは、原則としてタイトル形式の大文字表記を優先する。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Retain the English capitalization context and the generally-prefer wording even when a game has a different writing style.

conditions: The action opens another view for input or additional choices.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: A different view is typical, not a mandatory prerequisite for adding an ellipsis.

statement.en: Limit submenu hierarchy to one level and keep each submenu short.

statement.en: Generally keep submenus to one level and avoid excessive length.
statement.ja: サブメニューは通常1階層にとどめ、長くなりすぎないようにする。

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Restore generally-best-to for the one-level recommendation and retain about-five as the trigger for considering another menu, not a hard cap.

statement.en: Use the small iOS or iPadOS menu layout only for closely related actions that form a group.
statement.ja: iOSまたはiPadOSのsmall menu layoutはgroupを成す密接に関連したactionだけに使う。

statement.en: Use the small iOS or iPadOS menu layout only for closely related actions that typically appear as a group.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Retain typically-appear-as-a-group instead of permitting any newly formed set of actions.

conditions: People must identify each action without a text label.
The symbol helps people identify the action without a text label.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Describe the label-free recognition purpose without introducing a separate obligation on the person using the menu.

statement.en: Consider the medium iOS or iPadOS layout for three important, frequently used actions.
statement.ja: 重要で頻繁に使うactionが3つある場合はiOSまたはiPadOSのmedium layoutを検討する。

conditions: The app has exactly three important actions people often perform.

conditions: Three important, frequently desired actions are candidates for the top row; this does not limit the app’s total number of important actions.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Remove the invented app-wide exactly-three restriction and preserve often-want-to-perform rather than requiring observed frequent use.

statement.ja: 重要で頻繁に使うactionが3つある場合はiOSまたはiPadOSのmedium layoutを検討する。

conditions: The app has exactly three important actions people often perform.
HIG-COMPONENTS-MENUS-0031.review_note: Recovered the medium-layout recommendation and preserved its consider strength.

prior_batch_metadata.review_method: Rendered Apple HIG Menus guidance, supporting prose, labels, icons, organization, submenus, toggled items, in-game behavior, layout definitions, and visionOS effects were reviewed; two repeated live renders matched the stored main-content hash.
prior_batch_metadata.review_note: Completed Menus coverage; recovered ten atomic rules, retained all twenty-one existing IDs, captured iOS/iPadOS layout constraints, and reviewed breakthrough-effect alternatives.

review_method: Root reviewed 18 Labels, Icons, Organization, and Submenus rules; one helper independently reviewed 13 Toggled items, In-game menus, and Platform rules. Root reverified five exact sentence proofs and all helper corrections. Rechecked the three MUST outcomes: 0010, 0017, and 0027. Retained 0026 as a conditional alternative at MAY, consistent with its explicit prior review; the source uses If necessary, not consider. Classified the visionOS SwiftUI-view paragraph as capability/reference context rather than automatically creating another normative rule. Exact trace presence and semantic approval are separate checks.
unverified: Individual SDK availability, platform runtime behavior, and 3D breakthrough effects were not tested on devices.
Source media and former full-page prose were not compared or retained.
The visionOS SwiftUI-view capability was reviewed as reference context; this batch does not claim exhaustive extraction of every API capability.

extraction_verification.method: Isolated extraction; all canonical rule files and stable-ID registry matched byte-for-byte.
